title: Human Deviation Rate Log
description: An observable log of how often, and in what direction, a human reviewer's final decision deviates from an automated system's score or recommendation — the evidence that a human-review safeguard is genuine rather than symbolic.
evidence_description: A record, for each case reviewed, of the automated score/recommendation, the human reviewer's final decision, and whether they diverged — aggregated into a deviation rate over time. This is deliberately observable evidence, not a self-assessment: it is derived directly from the score and the recorded decision, not from a reviewer's own account of how carefully they considered the case.
collection_method: Automatically logged at decision time by comparing the system's score/recommendation to the recorded human decision.
artifact_format: Structured export (CSV/JSON) of per-case score/decision pairs and the aggregate deviation rate.

citations.title: Judgment of the Court (First Chamber), 7 December 2023 — OQ v Land Hessen (SCHUFA Holding, Scoring), Case C-634/21
citations.publisher: Court of Justice of the European Union
